description: 13.06 TERRAIN AND MOVEMENT: 'This INFANTRY model is not being moved over or through any terrain features. Its move through the terrain area shown is therefore unimpeded.' Regression: the legacy climb model read a terrain AREA's height (tall since 7846f06 re-derived recon_1's home objective areas) as a surface, so a VEHICLE / MONSTER moving into an area's open ground paid a 6" climb (and a charge 8"). Official layout take_and_hold_vs_reconnaissance_1 over the audit_baseline_postdeploy fixture: the player selects the Telemon Heavy Dreadnought (M8"), picks Normal Move and drags it 5" north into the open ground of home objective area area-large-7, touching no feature; the move costs 5 + 2" (the area's difficult ground) and is accepted; End This Unit's Move leaves it in the area.

steps.comment: a movement_phase_start window (not under test), if any

Setup: the official layout take_and_hold_vs_reconnaissance_1 (the fixture's own layout is restored in cleanup); the Telemon Heavy Dreadnought (VEHICLE WALKER, M8", 100mm base) on open battlefield at (32", 57.5"), 5" south of the open ground of home objective area area-large-7 (x 25.5-37", y 48-55", a tall dense AREA since 7846f06); every other unit but one far-away Boyz mob removed from play.

var main = tree.current_scene
main.view_zoom = 1.0
var vps = main.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
main.view_offset = Vector2(1240, 2160) - vps / (2.0 * main.view_zoom)
main.update_view_transform()
return true

steps.comment: 13.06: a move through an area's open ground is unimpeded — no climb; only the area's difficult ground (+2", unchanged). Before the fix the area's 'tall' height read as a 6" climb: 5 + 6 + 2 = 13" > M8", and a charge on the same line paid 8".
the Telemon is the only row of the movement unit list
Real player input: select the Telemon in the unit list.
real drag: 5" north into the area's open ground
the move was accepted: the Telemon ends in area-large-7's open ground (before the fix the drop was refused as 13" > 8" and the model snapped back)
steps.script:
var u = GameState.get_unit("U_TELEMON_HEAVY_DREADNOUGHT_I")
var m = u["models"][0]
var p = m["position"]
var ids = []
for pc in TerrainManager.pieces_model_within(m):
	ids.append(str(pc.get("id", "")))
ids.sort()
print("[%s] after the move: (%.2f, %.2f)in, within %s" % ["vehicle_enters_area_open_ground_11e", float(p.x) / 40.0, float(p.y) / 40.0, str(ids)])
return "%s|%s" % [str(absf(float(p.y) / 40.0 - 52.5) < 0.3), ",".join(PackedStringArray(ids))]
